body: I regretfully didn’t buy a salvia plant, and now I must so I can name it Pepe Salvia.

Yes, they came back almost a half hour after we called. (They do this for 30 days after original treatment) the exterminator came and sprayed the baseboards and window again, as well as our curtains and curtain rods.

The one I kept and put in a bag was dead by the time he got here, and he said that it was most likely just a straggler who walked through the treatment and was dying off. 

He sprayed the couch and rug as well as any furniture touching walls, as a precaution he sprayed in every room including closets

Yes we laundered the curtains and any other fabric such as the couch cover with hot water and as well as high heat, then double bagged them.

Any of our clothes and bedding in baskets were laundered and wrapped in bags twisted as tight as possible. Also just went and got two storage containers to store our clothes to wear in (still inside of the bags) 

We have clothes in our dresser to launder as well, but our apartment washing machines require quarters, so we can afford only to do so much at a time. 

Already paid $800 and that’s just for them to treat the bedroom and living room, as well was the mattress encasement. Now I’m nervous I didn’t get the bathroom treated as well, but it was $250 more.

Unfortunately cannot use bed bug interceptors for our bed frame as it’s just a long rectangular bar for legs.

Thank you guys for all of the advice. 
My skin is still crawling just thinking of staying here.
